title: One-Pan Lemon Herb Chicken
description: A simple weeknight chicken dinner with lemon, garlic, and herbs.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Place chicken and vegetables in a baking dish and coat with the mixture.
Bake until the thickest part of each chicken piece reaches 74°C (165°F), checking with a food thermometer.
Rest briefly and serve hot.
image_alt: Roasted lemon herb chicken with golden vegetables

title: Creamy Tomato Spinach Pasta
description: Comforting pasta with tomato, spinach, and a creamy sauce.
ingredients: 1/3 cup cooking cream or unsweetened plant-based alternative
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions; reserve a little pasta water.
Warm olive oil in a pan and cook garlic briefly without browning.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 8–10 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted, then add cream.
Toss with pasta, loosen with pasta water if needed, season, and serve.
image_alt: Pasta with sauce and fresh herbs

title: Roasted Chickpea Rainbow Bowls
description: A colorful bowl with roasted chickpeas, grains, and fresh vegetables.
instructions: Heat oven to 220°C (425°F).
Pat chickpeas dry, toss with olive oil and paprika, and spread on a tray.
Roast for 20–25 minutes, shaking the tray once.
Divide grains, cucumber, tomato, and greens among bowls.
Top with roasted chickpeas and serve with lemon.
image_alt: Colorful chickpea bowl with fresh vegetables

title: Honey Garlic Salmon Bowls
description: Make a balanced dinner with tender honey-garlic salmon, rice, and crisp vegetables.
instructions: Mix the honey, soy sauce, garlic, and olive oil.
Season the salmon and brush with the sauce.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 12–15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve over rice with cucumber and spoon the remaining cooked sauce over the salmon.
image_alt: Salmon served as a colorful dinner bowl

title: Crispy Black Bean Tacos
description: Crisp-edged black bean tacos with warm spices and fresh toppings for an easy meatless meal.
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed
Lime wedges and salsa, to serve
instructions: Mash half of the black beans with cumin and paprika.
Stir in the remaining beans.
Fill tortillas with the bean mixture and fold.
Cook in a lightly oiled skillet for 2–3 minutes per side until crisp.
Serve with avocado, lettuce, salsa, and lime.
image_alt: Tacos ready to serve with fresh toppings

title: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
description: A refreshing chickpea salad with cucumber, tomato, herbs, and a bright lemon dressing.
instructions: Combine chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, feta, and parsley in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently.
Chill for 10 minutes before serving, if time allows.
image_alt: Fresh colorful salad with vegetables and greens

title: Easy Roasted Vegetable Pasta
description: Roasted seasonal vegetables and pasta tossed with olive oil, garlic, and Parmesan.
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss zucchini, pepper, onion, and tomatoes with olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Roast for 20–25 minutes until tender and lightly browned.
Meanwhile, cook pasta according to its package directions and reserve a little pasta water.
Toss pasta with the roasted vegetables, Parmesan, and a splash of pasta water.
image_alt: Pasta tossed with vegetables and herbs

title: Creamy Lentil Coconut Curry
description: A warming one-pot red lentil curry simmered with coconut milk, tomatoes, and spices.
instructions: Cook the onion in a little oil until softened.
Add garlic, ginger, and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in lentils, tomatoes, coconut milk, and broth.
Simmer for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender.
Stir in spinach until wilted, then season and serve.
image_alt: A warm bowl of curry ready to serve

title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
description: Colorful peppers and seasoned chicken roast together for an easy weeknight fajita dinner.
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Arrange chicken, peppers, and onion on a sheet pan.
Toss with olive oil, chili powder, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Roast for 20–25 minutes, stirring halfway, until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) internally.
Serve in warm tortillas with lime wedges.
image_alt: Colorful fajita ingredients prepared for dinner

title: Banana Oat Breakfast Pancakes
description: Simple banana and oat pancakes for a comforting breakfast with everyday ingredients.
ingredients: A little oil for the pan
instructions: Mash the bananas in a bowl.
Whisk in eggs, oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and vanilla.
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes.
Cook small pancakes in a lightly oiled skillet over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes per side.
Serve warm with fresh fruit.
image_alt: A stack of pancakes served for breakfast

title: Quick Greek Yogurt Parfaits
description: Layer creamy Greek yogurt, crunchy granola, and fresh fruit for a quick breakfast or snack.
instructions: Spoon a layer of Greek yogurt into four glasses or jars.
Add granola and a layer of fruit.
Repeat the layers until the ingredients are used.
Finish with honey or chia seeds if desired.
Serve immediately for crunchy granola, or keep the granola separate until serving.
image_alt: Yogurt and fruit layered in a breakfast parfait

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken Rice Bowls
description: A practical rice bowls featuring lemon garlic chicken, everyday ingredients, and clear steps for an easy homemade meal.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.
Season the main ingredient with the listed flavorings and a pinch of salt.
Cook the main ingredient in a lightly oiled skillet until tender and safely cooked through.
Divide rice between bowls, add cucumber and carrots, and arrange the cooked topping over each bowl.
Finish with lemon or lime juice and serve warm.
image_alt: Illustrative food photograph for Lemon Garlic Chicken Rice Bowls

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken Roasted Vegetable Tray
description: A practical roasted vegetable tray featuring lemon garlic chicken, everyday ingredients, and clear steps for an easy homemade meal.
ingredients: 1 zucchini, 1 red bell pepper, and 1 red onion, chopped
2 tablespoons olive oil; 1 teaspoon dried oregano
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oven to 220°C (425°F) and line a large baking tray.
Spread vegetables on the tray and toss with olive oil, flavorings, salt, and pepper.
Add the main ingredient and arrange everything in a single layer.
Roast, turning once, until vegetables are browned and the main ingredient is safely cooked through.
Taste, adjust seasoning, and serve hot.
image_alt: Illustrative food photograph for Lemon Garlic Chicken Roasted Vegetable Tray

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken Quick Pasta
description: A practical quick pasta featuring lemon garlic chicken, everyday ingredients, and clear steps for an easy homemade meal.
ingredients: 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved; 2 cups baby spinach
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Boil salted water and cook pasta according to package directions.
Warm olive oil in a skillet and briefly cook the listed flavorings.
Add the main ingredient and cook until tender and safely cooked through, where applicable.
Stir in tomatoes and spinach; cook until tomatoes soften and spinach wilts.
Toss with drained pasta and a splash of pasta water, season, and serve.
image_alt: Illustrative food photograph for Lemon Garlic Chicken Quick Pasta

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken Warm Grain Salad
description: A practical warm grain salad featuring lemon garlic chicken, everyday ingredients, and clear steps for an easy homemade meal.
ingredients: 1 cucumber, diced; 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved; 2 tablespoons parsley
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Prepare quinoa or bulgur according to package directions and fluff with a fork.
Heat a skillet with olive oil and add the main ingredient with the listed flavorings.
Cook until hot and tender; ensure meat or seafood is safely cooked through.
Combine grain with cucumber, tomatoes, and parsley in a bowl.
Dress with lemon juice and olive oil, toss gently, and serve warm or chilled.
image_alt: Illustrative food photograph for Lemon Garlic Chicken Warm Grain Salad

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken One-Pot Soup
description: A practical one-pot soup featuring lemon garlic chicken, everyday ingredients, and clear steps for an easy homemade meal.
ingredients: 1 onion, diced; 2 carrots, sliced; 2 celery stalks, chopped
750 ml low-sodium vegetable or chicken broth
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Warm olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion, carrots, and celery; cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the main ingredient and flavorings, then pour in the broth.
Simmer until vegetables and main ingredient are tender and safely cooked through.
Season to taste and serve with herbs or whole-grain bread.
image_alt: Illustrative food photograph for Lemon Garlic Chicken One-Pot Soup

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken Tacos
description: A practical tacos featuring lemon garlic chicken, everyday ingredients, and clear steps for an easy homemade meal.
ingredients: 1 cup shredded cabbage; salsa and lime wedges
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Warm a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat.
Add the main ingredient and flavorings; cook until ready and safely cooked where applicable.
Adjust seasoning with salt, pepper, and lime.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan for about 30 seconds per side.
Fill tortillas with the cooked mixture and cabbage, then serve with salsa and lime.
image_alt: Illustrative food photograph for Lemon Garlic Chicken Tacos

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
description: A practical stuffed sweet potatoes featuring lemon garlic chicken, everyday ingredients, and clear steps for an easy homemade meal.
ingredients: 1 avocado, diced; 2 tablespoons plain yogurt or dairy-free alternative
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oven to 200°C (400°F), prick sweet potatoes with a fork, and place on a tray.
Bake 30–40 minutes until easily pierced with a knife.
Cook the main ingredient in a skillet with flavorings and a little olive oil.
Split sweet potatoes and fluff centers with a fork.
Fill with the cooked mixture and top with avocado and yogurt.
image_alt: Illustrative food photograph for Lemon Garlic Chicken Stuffed Sweet Potatoes

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken Breakfast Hash
description: A practical breakfast hash featuring lemon garlic chicken, everyday ingredients, and clear steps for an easy homemade meal.
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, diced; 4 eggs optional
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Parboil potatoes for 6 minutes, drain, and pat dry.
Cook potatoes in olive oil until golden, turning occasionally.
Add the main ingredient and flavorings; cook until tender and safely cooked through where applicable.
Stir in bell pepper and cook until just softened.
Serve as is or with eggs cooked safely to preference.
image_alt: Illustrative food photograph for Lemon Garlic Chicken Breakfast Hash

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken Fresh Wraps
description: A practical fresh wraps featuring lemon garlic chicken, everyday ingredients, and clear steps for an easy homemade meal.
ingredients: 4 whole-wheat wraps or large lettuce leaves
1 cucumber, sliced; 1 carrot, grated; 2 tablespoons yogurt or tahini sauce
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Prepare cucumber, carrot, and fresh toppings.
Cook the main ingredient with olive oil and flavorings until ready and safely cooked where applicable.
Let hot ingredients cool briefly.
Spread sauce over each wrap and add vegetables and filling.
Roll tightly, slice in half, and serve.
image_alt: Illustrative food photograph for Lemon Garlic Chicken Fresh Wraps

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken Coconut Curry
description: A practical coconut curry featuring lemon garlic chicken, everyday ingredients, and clear steps for an easy homemade meal.
ingredients: 1 onion, diced; 1 can (400 ml) coconut milk
1 can diced tomatoes; 2 cups vegetable broth or water
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Soften onion in a large pot with a little oil.
Add flavorings and stir for 30–60 seconds until fragrant.
Add main ingredient, coconut milk, tomatoes, and broth.
Simmer until ingredients are tender and sauce thickens; ensure meat or seafood is safely cooked through.
Season and serve with rice or warm flatbread.
image_alt: Illustrative food photograph for Lemon Garlic Chicken Coconut Curry

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken Loaded Salad
description: A practical loaded salad featuring lemon garlic chicken, everyday ingredients, and clear steps for an easy homemade meal.
ingredients: 1 cucumber, diced; 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved; 1/2 red onion, thinly sliced
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Wash and thoroughly dry salad greens.
Prepare cucumber, tomatoes, and onion and arrange over the greens.
Cook the main ingredient in olive oil with flavorings if it requires cooking.
Whisk 2 tablespoons olive oil with 1 tablespoon lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the topping, dress just before serving, and toss gently.
